title: Five new conferences: PSI, CDISC Interchange, PharmaRUG China, useR!, R/Medicine
notes: PSI (2025–2026): 146 conference abstracts from psiweb.org, with official PDF links — titles and authors are extracted from the PDFs themselves.
CDISC Interchange (2023–2026): 784 presentations from the official cdisc.org presentation archives across US, Europe, Japan, China, India and Korea editions.
PharmaRUG China (2023–2026): 57 talks from the official pharmarug.github.io site, with slides links.
useR! (2022 & 2025): 250 talks with abstracts and presenters from the official conference websites.
R/Medicine (2024–2025): 107 talks with abstracts from the R Consortium GitHub Pages site.
All five spiders run from official sources, so monthly scheduled scrapes will pick up new editions automatically.

title: Paper favorites & update history
notes: Star any paper card in the Browse view to save it — a Favorites view (#/favorites) groups saved papers by your own categories.
Favorites support categories, per-paper notes, keyword filtering, JSON export/import backups.
Favorites live in each visitor's own browser (localStorage): no account, no tracking, works for everyone who opens the site.
This Updates section is now generated from data/changelog.json.

title: PharmaSUG China proceedings fully re-scraped
notes: Reverse-engineered the official pharmasug.com.cn API and rebuilt the spider — PharmaSUG China grew from 460 to 758 papers (2012–2026).
2023–2026 editions now include full author lists and 292 direct PDF links from the official site.
